meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth - startup tips, working tips, and any Tip: line shown in the TUI (including the Fable-5-refusal fallback tip). Use when the user asks about a Tip: line, says give-me-tips, asks what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see. Queries the live tip list (senpi --list-tips) first, checks what THIS user can actually see, then verifies the real feature code before explaining.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入解释任何senpi提示的含义与用法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用senpi时想弄懂每条提示在说什么
copy.tagline_en: Explain any senpi tip in depth
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand what each senpi tip means and how to use it

howto.what: 装上后,当你问起 senpi 界面里看到的任何 Tip 提示时,Claude 会先查一下这条提示的真实来源,再结合你的个人设置讲解它为什么出现、背后的功能如何运作;如果提示文案与代码不符,会以代码为准说明。
howto.when: 当你说“give-me-tips”,或问某条 Tip 提示是什么意思、提示里的功能怎么用,或想知道自己能看到哪些提示时触发。

say.text: 解释一下我刚才看到的那条 Tip 行。
say.note: Claude 会先查实时列表,再核对代码后讲解。

say.text: 我能看到哪些提示,分别在什么时候出现?
say.note: 它会读你的 senpi 设置,只讲你实际可见的提示。

say.text: Fable 5 拒绝后出现的那条提示是怎么运作的?
say.note: 会深入解释整套回退机制。

howto.what_en: When you ask about any senpi tip, Claude checks its real source, reads your settings, and explains why it appears and how it works. If tip text and code conflict, code wins.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention a Tip: line, say 'give-me-tips', ask what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips you can see.

say_en.text: Explain the Tip: line I just saw.
say_en.note: Claude checks the live list and code before answering.

say_en.text: Which tips can I see, and when do they appear?
say_en.note: Reads your settings; only describes tips you can actually see.

say_en.text: How does the tip after a Fable 5 refusal work?
say_en.note: Explains the full fallback mechanism in depth.
